spd_deadline_rule: the summary plan descriptions are furnished within spd_deadline_days calendar days of hire_date; the deadline is hire_date plus spd_deadline_days, a company standard that is never later than a deadline counted from coverage_start_date
eligibility_statement: every active employee is benefits eligible: the smallest scheduled fraction in the hris export is 0.6, which is 24 hours on a 40 hour full-time week and above the 20 hour line the employee handbook sets
no_health_no_pay_statement: this census carries no money, no premium, no contribution, no deferral rate and no pay, which the compensation band dataset holds; no health field and no health value, because a benefits administration alert needs no health information and must not acquire any; and no dependent name, date of birth or age. The employee share of each premium is shown in the hris when an employee enrolls
